component.name: WeeChatRS
component.summary: Chat on IRC through WeeChat, soju, ZNC or directly

description.p: WeeChatRS is a native desktop client for IRC. Connect it to a WeeChat relay to use your running WeeChat from anywhere, or straight to IRC networks, the soju and ZNC bouncers, or the Injected IRC service.

ul.li: Several connections at once, with buffers grouped by network
History, read markers and search where the server keeps them
All networks of a soju or ZNC account from one login
Link previews, file uploads and desktop notifications
Themes, including your own Ghostty themes

screenshot.caption: A channel with the buffer and nick lists
Connections, with a ZNC account's networks

description.p: Menus with IRC operator commands, Moderation only where you can moderate, the Injected sign-in window on Linux, and the first Flatpak.
IRC operator menus, the Injected sign-in window on Linux, and the first Flatpak and Microsoft Store packages.
ZNC support, an experimental Injected backend, a hand-picked set of themes, and hiding and muting buffers on every backend.
